text:
A cable connected to an electric kettle has damaged insulation. The live wire inside the cable
is exposed.
What is a possible hazard of the damaged insulation?
A
A person touches the exposed wire and gets an electric shock.
B
The cable breaks and blows the fuse in the circuit.
C
The kettle boils and injures the person.
D
The kettle does not work if the live wire is exposed.

options.label: A
options.text: A person touches the exposed wire and gets an electric shock.

options.label: B
options.text: The cable breaks and blows the fuse in the circuit.

options.label: C
options.text: The kettle boils and injures the person.

options.label: D
options.text: The kettle does not work if the live wire is exposed.
